limitations: The path is a centripetal Catmull-Rom spline through your points: corners are rounded (spline_max_offset_m), it is not a recorded flight line.
The swept box is the craft body only (no margin, no banking or roll, no prop wash or flight dynamics); margin_m is applied to probe clearances (near-miss) only.
Evidence is the LIVE collision state of the open editor with the resident DLL; stock Uncrashed ignores MCP collision overrides. override-active findings were not tested with stock collision.
Which channel the drone really collides as is not verified (default Pawn); unknown responses count as blocking.
Objects with collision off are invisible to traces; Blueprint buildings can have floors without query collision, so no hit next to an unverified object is not clearance.
Nearby objects are found by pivot inside the path box widened by near_m: large objects with a far pivot can be missed.
Probes run in 16 horizontal directions plus up/down from each sample, not in every direction.
Geometry check only: not a flight test, visual check or proof that the line is flyable.
